content.title: About
content.content: Blackberry juice, 100% is a natural beverage obtained by pressing fresh blackberry berries without added sugar, preservatives or flavorings. It has a deep dark‑purple colour, a distinctive aroma and a mildly tart‑sweet taste.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Blackberries contain more than 20 different antioxidants, including anthocyanins that give the fruit its deep colour.
Blackberry juice is often used in culinary applications such as sauces, marinades and desserts.
In traditional Native American medicine, blackberries were used as a remedy for colds and inflammation.
If produced by cold‑press and quickly pasteurised, the juice retains a high proportion of vitamin C.
Blackberries grow in temperate climates and are harvested in late summer to early autumn.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Antioxidants help neutralise free radicals, supporting cellular health and slowing ageing processes.

items.title: Immune system support
items.content: Vitamin C in the juice contributes to a stronger immune response and increased resistance to infections.

items.title: Anti‑inflammatory properties
items.content: Flavonoids and anthocyanins exhibit anti‑inflammatory effects, which may benefit chronic inflammatory conditions.

items.title: Cardiovascular health
items.content: Polysaccharides and potassium help maintain normal blood pressure and improve vascular function.

items.title: Digestive aid
items.content: A small amount of fibre remaining after pressing supports a healthy gut microbiome.

items.title: Berry allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to blackberries, manifested as itching, swelling or rash.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although the juice is 100% natural, the inherent sugars in the fruit can be considerable; people with diabetes should monitor portion size.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: The acidic nature of the juice may irritate the stomach lining in persons with gastritis or ulcer disease.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drink the juice chilled as a refreshing beverage, add it to smoothies, cocktails, meat sauces or desserts. It pairs well with mint, lemon and ginger.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the juice in the refrigerator at 0 °C‑4 °C in its original container. Once opened, consume within 5‑7 days. When frozen, the juice retains its qualities for up to 3 months.
